text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"Organized paragraphs introduced by transitions like \"To begin with\", \"To continue\", and \"Last but not least\"","quality":"Structural Organization","description":"The degree to which the writing uses clear paragraphing and transitional phrases to guide the reader through the argument."},{"evidence":"Clear expression of ideas using understandable syntax despite grammatical errors","quality":"Grammatical Sentence Structure","description":"The ability to construct complete sentences that successfully convey intended meaning to the reader."},{"evidence":"Standard spelling of common and academic words such as \"activities\", \"important\", and \"understand\"","quality":"Spelling Accuracy","description":"The correct orthographic representation of standard English words."},{"evidence":"A distinct central claim supported by multiple reasons, examples, and explanations","quality":"Argumentative Development","description":"The extent to which an essay presents a clear position and supports it with coherent reasoning."}]}
